p14ReviewDiagnostics.note: P14's binary verdict review fields do not constitute LCSP-400 dimension judgments. The separate dimension-review contract checks structure and trace binding, not reviewer authenticity.

EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENCY.classInclusionRule: Macro-F1 uses legitimate rubric labels with gold or legitimate prediction support; error sentinels never become classes.
EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENCY.denominatorRule: Every eligible reviewed gold case for this dimension, including missing and unknown predictions.
EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENCY.falsePositiveFalseNegativePolicy: Aggregate multiclass rubric-label FP/FN totals; missing and unknown predictions add FN to their gold class and remain visible in error columns.
